zh-CN.title: 八仙聚力新增个人历练
items: 认证成员累计发言两次，可随机获得一款个人八仙聊天气泡
全空间聚力调整为两轮，在 8 点和 16 点仙力时分别随机解锁一款气泡
活动规则、奖池和进度展示同步更新，个人奖励与全空间奖励更容易区分
八位仙人按唤醒顺序展开，未解锁时呈现剪影，解锁后会展示彩色人物与唤醒成员头像

en.title: A personal Baxian quest arrives
items: Verified members can publish twice to receive one random personal Baxian chat bubble
The shared event now has two rounds, unlocking one random bubble at 8 and 16 Force
Rules, prizes, and progress have been refreshed to clearly separate personal and space-wide rewards
All eight immortals now form an awakening trail with silhouettes for locked stages and contributor portraits for unlocked stages
